Hi Amanda / team,

Attaching a first pass at the listing hero copy plus the short "AMI / BYO" usage guidance we want on the product page. Goal is to:
- get AWS Marketplace PM checklist sign-off on the AMI wording,
- confirm there are no Marketplace compliance flags on the headline variants, and
- validate the co-sell CTA mapping (we plan to surface "Request a demo" + co-sell tag).

Attachments: aws_hero_variants.docx (3 hero variants, 1-line subhead options), ami-usage-diagram.png (customer flow for BYO AMI).

Key asks:
1) Amanda: any required phrasing for AMI/bring-your-own-image statements so the listing passes the technical review?
2) Vanessa / Marissa: pick preferred hero and subhead and flag any legal/terms-sensitive wording.
3) DevOps (Acme contact): confirm the short AMI command snippet in the diagram is accurate for our onboarding script.

Draft hero variants (summary):
A) "High-throughput LLM inference that scales with your workload" — subhead: "Predictable latency and cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
B) "Ship LLM features with production-grade inference" — subhead: "Latency SLOs, smart routing, and cost controls for every deployment model."
C) "Make inference predictable and economical" — subhead: "Unified runtime for hosted, reserved, and private deployments."

Notes on AMI wording (draft snippet to add under "Deployment options"):
"For customers using AWS infrastructure, Redwood provides a verified AMI to simplify on-prem or EC2-based deployments. If you prefer to bring your own image (BYO AMI), follow the steps in our onboarding guide and ensure the instance type meets the recommended GPU/CPU profile."

I tried to keep the AMI guidance short — we can link to a longer guide in the tech docs.

Next steps: can we get comments by EOD Friday PT so Marissa can produce a final copy for the marketplace listing request early next week?

Thanks,

Thanks for sending this over, Soojin — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from the Marketplace review side: 

- Headline variants: we prefer A or C for clarity. Avoid words that imply managed data residency guarantees (e.g., "private deployments" is fine, but "air-gapped" must be clarified if you use it).
- AMI wording: please include a short sentence that the AMI is provided by Redwood Inference and is verified for use on supported instance types. Also add a link to the AMI EULA or terms (even if short).
- Technical check: in the ami-usage-diagram.png the EC2 CLI snippet is missing the --image-id placeholder. Please change the example to use "ami-xxxxxx" instead of the full AMI id we will assign.

Inline comment (quoted):
> Draft hero variants (summary):
> A) "High-throughput LLM inference that scales with your workload" 
> B) "Ship LLM features with production-grade inference" 
> C) "Make inference predictable and economical"

A and C are concise and marketplace-friendly; B is a bit marketing-y and might require extra substantiation in the listing body.

One more thing: we need to select a single short feature bullet to surface as the "What it does" summary (max 140 characters). Something like: "Low-latency, cost-aware LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments." — that would be my recommendation.

Amanda
Sr PM, AWS Marketplace
Amanda.cho@amazon.com
